messages:
alex: heads-up: customer using Lerna monorepo sees runtime "Cannot find module 'redwood-sdk'" inside a hoisted package. only happens when installed via yarn workspaces/pnpm hoisting.
maria: interesting. are they using a workspace alias or path mapping? hoisting + conditional exports can confuse older resolvers.
lee: do we expose a top-level main? what does package.json exports look like in sdk@6.4.x?
alex: exports: { ".": { "import": "./esm/index.mjs", "default": "./cjs/index.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" } and types: "dist/index.d.ts". no explicit "require" condition or "main".
maria: hoisted installs sometimes create a synthetic package layout where Node's resolver tries to read package.json of the workspace root instead of the hoisted package. if conditional exports are present but bundler resolves differently, it may skip the package altogether. yarn classic and pnpm create different layouts.
lee: customers using ts-node or older tsserver in mono repos hit a second issue: types resolve to the package root but TS compiler can't follow exports so intellisense breaks.
ci-bot: CI matrix failure: samples/workspace-integration (yarn-workspaces, node14) -> exit 1. Logs: Error: Cannot find module 'redwood-sdk' from packages/ui/src/index.js
maria: immediate short-term fix: publish patch that adds top-level "main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs" and an explicit "require" condition in exports. also consider adding a small "exports" entry for "./*" to help workspace bundlers.
lee: also add a note in packaging docs about workspace hoisting: recommend adding "preferRelative": true in consumers or pinning to node16+. And include a tiny smoke test in CI matrix: yarn-workspaces + pnpm-workspaces + node14/16.
alex: I'll reply to customer with workaround: pin to sdk@6.3.x or add a local resolution alias in root package.json: "resolutions": { "redwood-sdk": "./packages/sdk" } until we ship patch.
ci-bot: PR created redwood/sdk#512 - add main/require export and workspace smoke tests. pipeline started.
maria: long-term: we should add a devex doc titled "Packaging for Monorepos and Hoisting" with recommended exports + main + types pattern and sample yarn/pnpm configs. Also include a reproducible repo for future debugging.
lee: agreed. I'll shepherd the PR. alex, can you paste the minimal repro for the ticket?
alex: done in the ticket: repo link + steps using yarn workspaces + node14. closing the loop for now.
